title: Is it possible to purchase the 2k version of rpg maker outside steam?

posts.author: taiguerrobocopi
posts.body: It's not listed on the downloads or products page.

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Buy RPG Maker 2000 from the Humble Store
For the first time, RPG Maker 2000 is available in English! Since its debut 15 years ago, the beloved game-making engine has introduced untold amounts of users to the wonders of game design and continues to be a powerful, user-friendly tool. No other engine in the RPG Maker series comes closer...
www.humblebundle.com
Humble Bundle has it for sale, giving both a DRM-free download and a Steam key as per the page.
